method: One-second, 10-ms-interval native process stack sample during final BAM merge
observation: Most sampled sort threads were waiting; read and write syscalls were present. A nearby ps snapshot showed 0.1 percent CPU while an iostat device snapshot showed 890 MB/s aggregate disk6 traffic. Device-wide traffic does not attribute all IO to this process.
source: sorted_bam.rs creates one run-reader and one decoder thread per spilled run; 105 runs in this benchmark. Output already uses a 4-MiB BufWriter.
scope: Diagnostic observation, not a controlled storage comparison or confirmed root cause. No code or output settings changed.
